Welcome. This video explains how to use the photo frame: turning it on, connecting it to Wi-Fi, adding photos and controlling it with the TV remote.
Then the power: it starts on its own

Connect the frame to the TV with the HDMI cable, then plug in its power supply. It has no button: it starts on its own. After half a minute, this screen appears. Allow about a minute and a half before the first photos.
It leads to the management page
If the frame knows the home Wi-Fi, it connects to it on its own, then shows this QR code for thirty seconds. It leads to the photo management page.
No known network: the frame creates its own
Scan the QR code with your phone

If it knows no network, for example at someone else's home, the frame creates its own Wi-Fi, called Cadre Photo Setup. Scan this QR code with your phone to join it. The password changes at every start and stays on the screen.
The page opens on its own
Choose the network, type its password

The setup page then opens on its own on the phone. Choose the home Wi-Fi, type its password and tap Connect. The frame joins the home network, and the QR code of the management page appears on the TV.
QR code on the TV, or http://cadre.local
Settings by theme: slideshow, photos, screen

To manage the frame, scan the QR code shown on the TV, or type cadre dot local in the browser of a phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi. At the top of the page are the settings: the transition between photos, how long each one stays, shuffle, the date and place on the photos, and sleep at night. They are grouped by theme: the slideshow, what appears on the photos, and the screen. The page language is chosen at the top right, and the frame's language in the screen settings.
Drop the photos, or tap to choose them

To add photos, drop them in the dotted area, or tap it to choose them on your phone. They appear in the gallery and in the slideshow a few seconds later. To remove some, select them, then tap Delete selection.
Paste the link in the management page

You can also link a shared iCloud album. On the iPhone, open the album, tap the people icon and turn on Public Website. Then copy the link and paste it into the management page. The frame checks the album every thirty minutes, and its photos are framed in orange in the gallery.
Place and date taken, bottom right
Place: phone photos and iCloud album (WhatsApp removes it)

During the slideshow, the place and date each photo was taken appear at the bottom right. Each can be turned on or off in the management page. The place is known for photos taken with a phone and for those in the iCloud album, but not for photos received through WhatsApp, which removes this information.
“2 years ago”: photos taken on this day
Sparkle: photo added in the last 24 h

The frame brings your memories back: photos taken on the same day in past years come back often, with the words two years ago. A blue sparkle marks photos added less than a day ago. And if you wish, the time and the weather appear at the bottom left, with a small icon.
Eye: hidden from the slideshow, but kept

In the gallery, the star marks a favourite photo: it comes back more often. The eye hides a photo from the slideshow without deleting it. In the settings, you can also choose what plays: the iCloud album, the uploaded photos, the favourites, or a period.
Banner on the photos, or a screen between them

For a special occasion, you can show a message on the frame. In the Message on the frame section, type your text, choose a banner at the top of the photos or a screen between the photos, and if you like, a start and end date. Tap Show. The message disappears on its own after the end date, or when you tap Remove.
OK  QR code of the management page
If the TV allows it, its remote controls the frame. Right arrow: next photo. Left arrow: previous photo. Up or down arrow: pause, and again to resume. OK button: the QR code of the management page.
Buttons at the bottom of the management page
Unplug once the green light is off
Password for the page, if needed

At the bottom of the management page are the Restart and Shut down buttons. Before unplugging the frame, shut it down this way and wait for its green light to go off. This is also where you can protect the page with a password.

To update the frame, open the management page, Update section, and tap Check for updates. If a new version exists, tap Install this version. You can also install a dot cadre file received by message. The frame checks that it really comes from the person who looks after it, installs it, then verifies that everything works; at the slightest problem, it restores the previous version on its own. Allow three minutes; the page keeps you informed.

If something goes wrong, the Diagnostics section prepares a report for the person who looks after the frame. Leave the boxes ticked, choose the period, then tap Download the report, and send them the file by message. Passwords are not included.
Not responding: unplug, plug back in
Wi-Fi lost: it recreates its network
Black screen: check the TV's HDMI input

If something goes wrong: if the frame stops responding, unplug it and plug it back in; it also restarts on its own if it freezes. If it loses the Wi-Fi for more than two minutes, it recreates its setup network. And if the screen stays black, check that the TV is on the right HDMI input.
That's it, you know everything. Enjoy your slideshow!
